content: Did the coloring in the vscode plugin recently change? My comments are now grey when I feel like they should be green, and a lot of keywords have turned an ominous red. Assuming I'm not making this up, how do I find the old color scheme?

Potentially from this change in VS Code 1.113 (March):

VS Code now ships with new default themes: "VS Code Light" and "VS Code Dark"

Possibly; almost certainly something closely related.

It looks like I had gotten switched to a color theme named Dark 2026; I had previously been using Dark (Visual Studio).
